CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is provided.

COD.rationale: Content (red), its organization/origin metadata, and a separate organizational presentation (blue coordinate) are all explicitly reported for the same p0/current/n0 entry.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement is linked to the reported content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify items (red/blue) with coordinate attributes in current records.

D.rationale: The report separately lists identified content coordinates and distinct origin/organization metadata for the same content entries.

O.rationale: The text describes how content is organized/presented (origin metadata and grouped candidate coordinate sets) in the current records.
